title: DependencyEdge
description: First-class typed edge between any two atomic units. Replaces v1's phase-adjacency inference. See 00_DESIGN.md section 2.1.

hard.description: true = dispatcher will not fire 'from' until 'to' satisfies the edge type. false = advisory only, dispatcher warns but does not block.

evidence.description: Optional pointer to an IFACE- interface contract or provenance line that grounds this edge in something concrete rather than assumed.
